title: GitHub - twigg-vc/monorepo: Twigg - version control
excerpt: Twigg - version control. Contribute to twigg-vc/monorepo development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
What is it?

Twigg is an open source version control system and software forge with batteries included.

It is not a Git wrapper: everything was written from scratch.

Compared to other version control systems, Twigg is more opinionated and built for one specific scenario: collaboration in closed teams. It implements the battle-tested workflow used across big tech for high-velocity, safe collaboration:

  • Trunk-based development: a single main development branch, no long-lived feature branches.
  • Small incremental changes: changes are independently reviewed and submitted in small commits that build on top of each other (stacked commits).

This workflow is possible without Twigg, but painful and only works if everyone remembers to follow it. In Twigg it's the default, and everything else is built around it:

  • Hierarchical Code Ownership: natively supported
  • Efficient Code Review: designed for reviewing stacked changes that evolve based on feedback
  • Integrated CI/CD: built to run on the trunk and to only trigger based on modified paths

Full documentation: twigg.vc/docs

Why is this on GitHub?

Naturally, we eat our own dogfood: Twigg is developed using Twigg. The actual development happens on our hosted instance at twigg.vc. However, Twigg doesn't yet support public repositories, so we use GitHub as a read-only mirror.

What's in this repo?

Basically everything but "secrets" (i.e. passwords). If you look around, you'll see this repository contains not only all the source code but even the runbooks we use to deploy our services. This is intentional. We can't rely on security through obscurity, and we believe radical transparency is essential to the success of this project.

Getting started

We host Twigg under twigg.vc with free and paid plans so you can easily try it out without having to self-host.

It offers Git Mirror functionality: all submitted commits are pushed to a Git repository. This allows you to test it out but easily switch back to a Git server if needed.

See a tutorial here.

FAQ

Why is it called Twigg?

A twig is a short branch - which is what Twigg wants your branches to be.

Is it production ready?

Yes. Twigg has been used in production for more than a year not only for Twigg's own development but also by 3 partner companies.

That said, when compared to projects such as Git, Twigg is relatively new; so backups (which you can easily enable with the Git Mirror functionality) are recommended.

Running and building locally

All the build scripts use the Twigg CLI to tag the build commit number. Thus, you must install the CLI before running any build script.

  • Requirements: go
  • cd tw && go install

To check the installation, run tw version.

Running locally

Note: both servers only run on Linux.

twigg-web is the "main" web server you see in twigg.vc. It hosts repositories, the documentation, the CLI binaries and everything else. To run it locally:

  • Requirements: tw CLI, go, node and task
  • cd twigg-web && task setup && task run

twigg-track is the server "in which the runners run" (hence the name Track), i.e. the server that runs CI/CD jobs. To run it locally:

  • Requirements: tw CLI, go, docker (required for running jobs in containers) and LXD (required for running jobs in VMs)
  • cd twigg-track && task run
  • Tip: task mock runs it with a mocked runner instead - no docker or LXD required.

If both servers are running locally, twigg-web will post jobs to twigg-track.

You can then install the CLI following the local instance's docs. The only caveat is: cloning a repo won't work because you must change the server's URL (which is set to https://twigg.vc by default for safety). To clone an example repository you should instead run: mkdir BookOne && cd BookOne && tw init && tw enable-unsafe-dev-mode true && tw unsafe-server http://localhost:9001/aang/BookOne. Then, generate a key in http://localhost:9001/user-settings and run tw key <key copied from the browser>. Running tw pull and tw push should now work.

Building from source

Ensure you have all the required dependencies:

  • tw CLI is required for any task build script
  • go is required for any build
  • task and make are used for build scripts
  • docker and LXD are required for running jobs in the CI/CD server
  • node is used to build the VSCode extension and the web components used by twigg-web

Build commands:

  • cd twigg-web && task setup && task build: download node deps and build the web server. Note that this also builds the CLI for all platforms and embeds them into the binary.
  • cd twigg-track && task build: build the CI/CD server.
  • cd twigg-vscode && make setup && make install: install the VSCode extension.

To run all tests: make test-all from repo root

content_html_zh:
它是什么？

Twigg 是一个开源版本控制系统和包含电池的软件锻造。

它不是 Git 包装器：一切都是从头开始编写的。

与其他版本控制系统相比，Twigg 更加固执己见，并且是为一种特定场景而构建的：封闭团队中的协作。 它实现了大型科技公司所使用的经过实战检验的工作流程，以实现高速、安全的协作：

  • 基于主干的开发：单个主要开发分支，没有长期存在的功能分支。
  • 小的增量更改：更改被独立审查并在相互构建的小提交（堆叠提交）中提交。

这个工作流程在没有 Twigg 的情况下也是可行的，但是很痛苦，而且只有每个人都记得遵循它才有效。 在 Twigg 中，它是默认值，其他所有内容都是围绕它构建的：

  • 分层代码所有权：本机支持
  • 高效的代码审查：旨在审查基于反馈而演变的堆叠变更
  • 集成 CI/CD：构建为在主干上运行并且仅根据修改的路径触发

完整文档：twigg.vc/docs

为什么这个会出现在 GitHub 上？

当然，我们吃自己的狗粮：Twigg 是使用 Twigg 开发的。 实际的开发发生在我们位于 twigg.vc 的托管实例上。 不过，Twigg 尚不支持公共存储库，因此我们使用 GitHub 作为只读镜像。

这个仓库里有什么？

基本上除了“秘密”（即密码）之外的所有内容。 如果您环顾四周，您会发现此存储库不仅包含所有源代码，甚至还包含我们用于部署服务的运行手册。 这是故意的。 我们不能通过默默无闻来依赖安全，我们相信彻底的透明度对于该项目的成功至关重要。

入门

我们在 twigg.vc 下托管 Twigg，提供免费和付费计划，因此您可以轻松尝试，而无需自行托管。

它提供 Git 镜像功能：所有提交的提交都会推送到 Git 存储库。 这允许您对其进行测试，但如果需要，可以轻松切换回 Git 服务器。

请参阅此处的教程。

FAQ

为什么叫特维格？

twig 是一根短树枝 - 这就是 Twigg 希望你的树枝成为的样子。

生产准备好了吗？

是的。 Twigg 已经在生产中使用了一年多，不仅用于 Twigg 自己的开发，还被 3 个合作公司使用。

也就是说，与 Git 等项目相比，Twigg 相对较新；因此建议进行备份（您可以使用 Git 镜像功能轻松启用备份）。

本地运行和构建

所有构建脚本都使用 Twigg CLI 来标记构建提交号。 因此，您必须在运行任何构建脚本之前安装 CLI。

  • 要求：去
  • cd tw && 去安装

要检查安装，请运行 tw 版本。

本地运行

注意：两台服务器仅在 Linux 上运行。

twigg-web 是您在 twigg.vc 中看到的“主”Web 服务器。 它托管存储库、文档、CLI 二进制文件和其他所有内容。 要在本地运行它：

  • 要求：tw CLI、go、节点和任务
  • cd twigg-web && 任务设置 && 任务运行

twigg-track 是“运行者运行的服务器”（因此称为 Track），即运行 CI/CD 作业的服务器。 要在本地运行它：

  • 要求：tw CLI、go、docker（在容器中运行作业所需）和 LXD（在虚拟机中运行作业所需）
  • cd twigg-track && 任务运行
  • 提示：任务模拟使用模拟运行器运行它 - 不需要 docker 或 LXD。

如果两台服务器都在本地运行，twigg-web 会将作业发布到 twigg-track。

然后，您可以按照本地实例的文档安装 CLI。 唯一需要注意的是：克隆存储库不起作用，因为您必须更改服务器的 URL（为了安全起见，默认设置为 https://twigg.vc）。 要克隆示例存储库，您应该运行： mkdir BookOne && cd BookOne && tw init && tw enable-unsafe-dev-mode true && tw unsafe-server http://localhost:9001/aang/BookOne。然后，在 http://localhost:9001/user-settings 中生成密钥并运行 tw key <从浏览器复制的密钥>。 运行 tw pull 和 tw push 现在应该可以工作了。

从源头构建

确保您拥有所有必需的依赖项：

  • 任何任务构建脚本都需要 tw CLI
  • 任何构建都需要 go
  • task 和 make 用于构建脚本
  • 在 CI/CD 服务器中运行作业需要 docker 和 LXD
  • Node 用于构建 VSCode 扩展以及 twigg-web 使用的 Web 组件

构建命令：

  • cd twigg-web && 任务设置 && 任务构建：下载节点 deps 并构建 Web 服务器。 请注意，这还会为所有平台构建 CLI 并将它们嵌入到二进制文件中。
  • cd twigg-track && 任务构建：构建 CI/CD 服务器。
  • cd twigg-vscode && make setup && make install：安装 VSCode 扩展。

要运行所有测试：从 repo root 进行 test-all
